decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The use of the ground floor and basement of the premises shall be as a dental practice only and for no other purpose within Class D 1 of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes Order) 1987 (as amended), and shall be for the occupation and benefit of one dental practitioner only at any one time..
Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of materials to be used for the proposed shopfront have first been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - A shop window display shall be provided at the first bringing into operation of the D1 use and shall continue to be displayed all times.

Condition : 5 - The times of opening of the dental practice to customers shall be restricted to between the hours of 9am and 6pm Mondays to Fridays, and to between 9am and 2pm on Saturdays, and not at any time on Sundays or public holidays.

Condition : 6 - The refuse storage areas for the residential unit will be provided as indicated on plan No. SP 384/03 'E' and for the ground floor dental practice in the basement storage area as indicated by letter dated 12th December 2008 received 17th December 2008.  The facilities proposed shall be provided and shall be brought into use on the first operation of the respective uses and shall thereafter be retained.

Condition : 7 - The first and second floor maisonette shall not be brought into use until or unless it has first been acoustically insulated, with any associated ventilation, to ensure that the maximum noise level within the unit, with windows shut, and any other necessary means of ventilation provided, does not exceed the "good" limits contained in BS8233:1999.  These being LAeq, 16hour = 30 dB in living rooms, and a night (07:00 - 23:00) LAeq, 8hour = 30 dB and LAFmax = 45 dB in bedrooms, and a night LAeq, 1 hour = 45 dB in kitchens, bathrooms, and utility rooms.

Condition : 8 - Full ambulant disabled access shall be maintained to the rear of the property at all times for customers needing to use wheelchairs.  Appropriate arrangements shall be made in advance of wheelchair bound customer visits to the dental practice for the side access gate to be opened and for those customers to be escorted to the rear access of the premises. In addition, the proposed access details to the front of the dental practice shall be implemented only in accordance with revised drawings Nos. SP 384/03 'D' and SP 384/06 'D' as received 17th November 2008.
description: Change of use of ground floor A1 (shop) to D1 (Dental Surgery) and upper floors from ancillary offices to a 2 bed maisonnette, together with external alterations to front elevation to provide new shop front.
